earnings.title: FedEx Reports Strong Third Quarter Results
highlights: Operating income $1.07 billion $1.20 billion $0.97 billion $1.03 billion
Net income $0.29 billion $0.90 billion $0.65 billion $0.69 billion
Completed $2 Billion of Share Repurchases in June-September Period

quotes.text: As our strong operating results and adjusted free cash flow demonstrate, FedEx is winning across high-value market segments while we optimize our network, driving an increase to our full-year outlook.
Our solid third quarter results and higher 2026 financial outlook reflect the focused execution of our strategy, demonstrating momentum toward our 2029 financial targets.

outlook: Revenue Growth ~12% YoY Compared to the prior forecast of ~11%.

(Continuing Operations) $35.30 to $35.90 Compared to the prior forecast of $16.55 to $17.75 per diluted share, which excluded impacts related to MTM accounting for the FedEx Freight investment and gain on extinguishment of debt.
(Continuing Operations) $18.00 to $18.60 Compared to the prior forecast of $16.90 to $18.10 per diluted share.
(ETR) ~22.5% Compared to the prior forecast of ~23%.

items.heading: We are directly affected by the state of the global economy and geopolitical developments.

Additional changes in international trade policies, including tariffs, and relations could significantly reduce the volume of goods transported globally, increase our costs, and materially and adversely affect our business, financial condition, cash flows, and results of operations.
Our transportation businesses and their profitability are affected by the price and availability of jet and vehicle fuel, as well as our ability to collect fuel surcharges.
The failure to successfully execute our transformation initiatives in the expected time frame and at the expected cost may materially and adversely affect our future results.

A significant data breach or other disruption to our technology infrastructure could disrupt our operations and result in the loss of critical sensitive or confidential information, adversely affecting our reputation, business, or results of operations.

We are self-insured for certain costs associated with our operations, and insurance and claims expenses could materially and adversely affect our business, financial condition, cash flows, and results of operations.
